settings.title: HERON RIB DRAINAGE MATTING
settings.text:
Designed to deliver exceptional performance in wet area applications, Heron Rib II Matting is an excellent slip resistant PVC anti-fatigue matting with a four way drainage system with built in antimicrobial protection.

Starting at $17.12/Sq ft.
Wet area safety mats with special properties and materials.

settings.title: VYNAGRIP SAFETY DRAINAGE mats
settings.text:
Built from top quality material, Vynagrip offers a very high slip resistant rating and drainage rating that meet the highest international standards. Vynagrip is also effective in offering anti-fatigue benefits.

Starting at $18.75/Sq ft.

settings.title: DURITE INDUSTRIAL MATS
settings.text:
Durite Industrial Anti-fatigue Mats are made from recycled tire links woven on galvanized steel wires and can withstand heaviest traffic a long time. Ideal for withstanding ice skates and ski boots traffic.

Starting at $26.55/Sq ft.

settings.title: NIRU VERSA RUNNER MATs
settings.text:
Designed to withstand harsh chemicals, greases, oils, and animal fats while creating a slip resistant work surface. Slotted perforations allow for drainage and a scraper-rib design makes for added traction.

Starting at $5.75/Sq ft.

settings.title: CM VIPER DRAIN THROUGH MATS
settings.text:
Made of natural, recycled, and nitrile rubber, these mats are slip resistant with small holes to scrape away dirt and allow water to drain through. They are perfect for use in commercial kitchens with heavy traffic.

Starting at $29.99/Sq ft.

settings.title: EYEWASH STATION MAT
settings.text:
With a Waffle grid, this mat drains fast, keeps dry and is slip resistant making it the perfect mat for emergency eyewash and shower stations. Made out of 100% recycled vinyl and available in highly visible colors. Comes assembled and ready to use.

Starting at $41.88/Sq ft.
